Journalist Yvonne Okwara has expressed disappointment after former Chief Justice David Maraga was whisked away to safety the moment police fired tear gas at families of June 25 victims marching to Parliament.
Maraga, who is widely respected for his stance on justice and police accountability, was pulled from the scene while parents of slain protesters Rex Masai and Kennedy Onyango remained in the chaos. Okwara said she did not expect him to be removed under those circumstances, leaving the grieving families exposed as tear gas was fired. #davidmaraga
